story.text: 여행 마지막 날, 공주역 플랫폼까지 배웅을 나갔습니다. 기차 시간이 야속하게 다가오고 있었습니다.
story.reading: yeo-haeng ma-ji-mak nal, gong-ju-yeok peul-laet-pom-kka-ji bae-ung-eul na-gass-seum-ni-da. gi-cha si-gan-i ya-sok-ha-ge da-ga-o-go it-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: On the last day of the trip, I went to see my friend off at the Gongju station platform. The train's departure time was approaching all too soon.

story.text: "이번 여행 덕분에 우리 '우정'이 한층 더 단단해진 것 같습니다." 저는 플랫폼 표지판을 괜히 만지작거리며 말했습니다.
story.reading: "i-beon yeo-haeng deok-bun-e u-ri 'u-jeong'-i han-cheung deo dan-dan-hae-jin geot gat-seum-ni-da." jeo-neun peul-laet-pom pyo-ji-pan-eul gwaen-hi man-ji-jak-geo-ri-myeo mal-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "Thanks to this trip, I think our 'friendship' has grown even more solid." I said this while fidgeting idly with the platform sign.

story.text: "우리, '영원히' 이렇게 지내자." 친구의 말에 저는 씩 웃으며 고개를 끄덕였습니다.
story.reading: "u-ri, 'yeong-won-hi' i-reo-ke ji-nae-ja." chin-gu-ui mal-e jeo-neun ssik us-eu-myeo go-gae-reul kkeu-deog-yeot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "Let's stay like this 'forever'." At my friend's words, I grinned and nodded.

story.text: 기차가 들어온다는 안내 방송이 울렸습니다. 짐을 챙기는 친구의 손을 잠시 붙잡았습니다.
story.reading: gi-cha-ga deul-eo-on-da-neun an-nae bang-song-i ul-lyeot-seum-ni-da. jim-eul chaeng-gi-neun chin-gu-ui son-eul jam-si but-jab-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: The announcement rang out that the train was arriving. I held onto my friend's hand for a moment as they gathered their things.

story.text: "언제든 저를 '든든한' 친구로 생각해 주십시오. 타워처럼 늘 여기 있겠습니다." 진심을 담아 말했습니다.
story.reading: "eon-je-deun jeo-reul 'deun-deun-han' chin-gu-ro saeng-gak-hae ju-sip-si-o. ta-wo-cheo-reom neul yeo-gi it-get-seum-ni-da." jin-sim-eul dam-a mal-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "Please always think of me as a 'reliable' friend. I'll always be here, like a tower." I said it with real sincerity.

story.text: 함께 다니고, 함께 웃고, 함께 밥을 먹던 며칠. 앞으로도 자주 '함께할' 순간을 만들자고 약속했습니다.
story.reading: ham-kke da-ni-go, ham-kke ut-go, ham-kke bab-eul meok-deon myeo-chil. ap-eu-ro-do ja-ju 'ham-kke-hal' sun-gan-eul man-deul-ja-go yak-sok-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: The past few days of going places together, laughing together, eating together. We promised to keep making moments to 'be together' often from now on too.

story.text: "다음엔 제가 먼저 연락하겠습니다." 저는 스스로에게, 그리고 친구에게 그렇게 조용히 '다짐했습니다.'
story.reading: "da-eum-en je-ga meon-jeo yeol-lak-ha-get-seum-ni-da." jeo-neun seu-seu-ro-e-ge, geu-ri-go chin-gu-e-ge geu-reo-ke jo-yong-hi 'da-jim-haess-seum-ni-da.'
story.en: "Next time, I'll be the one to reach out first." I quietly 'vowed' that, both to myself and to my friend.

story.text: 기차 문이 닫히기 직전, 친구가 창밖으로 손을 흔들며 소리쳤습니다. "타워, 또 보자!"
story.reading: gi-cha mun-i dat-hi-gi jik-jeon, chin-gu-ga chang-bakk-eu-ro son-eul heun-deul-myeo so-ri-chyeot-seum-ni-da. "ta-wo, tto bo-ja!"
story.en: Just before the train doors closed, my friend waved through the window and called out. "Tower, see you again!"

story.text: 기차가 완전히 사라질 때까지 플랫폼에 서서 손을 흔들었습니다. 그날 플랫폼에서 나눈 마지막 대화를 들려드리겠습니다.
story.reading: gi-cha-ga wan-jeon-hi sa-ra-jil ttae-kka-ji peul-laet-pom-e seo-seo son-eul heun-deul-eot-seum-ni-da. geu-nal peul-laet-pom-e-seo na-nun ma-ji-mak dae-hwa-reul deul-lyeo-deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: I stood on the platform waving until the train completely disappeared from view. Let me share the last conversation we had on that platform that day.

words.example: 우리의 우정은 십 년째 이어지고 있습니다.
words.example_reading: u-ri-ui u-jeong-eun sip nyeon-jjae i-eo-ji-go it-seum-ni-da
words.example_en: Our friendship has continued for ten years now.
I will remember this moment forever.
With my friend by my side, I feel reassured.
I want to share good moments together from now on too.
We vowed to each other that we would meet again.

sentences.en: Our friendship will continue on into the future.

sentences.ko: 우리는 영원히 좋은 친구로 남을 것입니다.
sentences.reading: u-ri-neun yeong-won-hi jo-eun chin-gu-ro nam-eul geot-im-ni-da
sentences.en: We will remain good friends forever.
You are truly a reliable presence to me.
I want to spend time together often in the future too.
I vowed to myself that I would reach out again.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 이번 여행, 정말 즐거웠습니다. 우리 우정이 더 깊어진 것 같습니다.
turns.reading: i-beon yeo-haeng, jeong-mal jeul-geo-wot-seum-ni-da. u-ri u-jeong-i deo gip-eo-jin geot gat-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: This trip was really fun. I think our friendship has grown even deeper.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 맞아. 우리 이렇게 영원히 친구로 지내자.
turns.reading: maj-a. u-ri i-reo-ke yeong-won-hi chin-gu-ro ji-nae-ja.
turns.en: Right. Let's stay friends like this forever.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 네, 약속하겠습니다. 언제든 든든한 친구가 되어 드리겠습니다.
turns.reading: ne, yak-sok-ha-get-seum-ni-da. eon-je-deun deun-deun-han chin-gu-ga doe-eo deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: Yes, I promise. I'll always be a reliable friend to you.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 고마워, 상우야. 다음에 또 이렇게 함께하자.
turns.reading: go-ma-wo, sang-u-ya. da-eum-e tto i-reo-ke ham-kke-ha-ja.
turns.en: Thanks, Sangwoo. Let's be together like this again next time.

dialogues.question: 상우와 승객이 서로에게 다짐한 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sangwoo and the passenger vow to each other?
dialogues.correct_answer: 영원히 친구로 지내며 든든한 사이가 되자는 것
options: 영원히 친구로 지내며 든든한 사이가 되자는 것
다음 여행 비용을 나눠 내자는 것
dialogues.explanation: 두 사람은 영원히 친구로 지내며 서로에게 든든한 존재가 되어 주자고 다짐했습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 기차 온다! 나 이제 가야 해.
turns.reading: gi-cha on-da! na i-je ga-ya hae.
turns.en: The train's here! I have to go now.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 네, 다음엔 제가 먼저 연락하겠습니다. 이건 제 다짐입니다.
turns.reading: ne, da-eum-en je-ga meon-jeo yeol-lak-ha-get-seum-ni-da. i-geon je da-jim-im-ni-da.
turns.en: Yes, next time I'll reach out first. This is my vow.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: I'll look forward to it! Tower, see you again!

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 네, 잘 가요. 다음 만남까지, 늘 응원하겠습니다.
turns.reading: ne, jal ga-yo. da-eum man-nam-kka-ji, neul eung-won-ha-get-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: Take care. Until we meet again, I'll be cheering for you always.

dialogues.question: 상우가 헤어지기 전에 한 다짐은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sangwoo vow before they parted?
options: 다음 여행 계획을 미리 짜겠다는 것
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 다음에는 자신이 먼저 연락하겠다고 다짐했습니다.
